question: After fixing AX measurement validity — longest-prefix element-pattern mapping without fallback, task-specific navigation to category/product/cart start_url (not ?task= homepage) for >=20 live CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree trees at 1280x720 across >=10 families 2-per-family (seed 35725763380), and pinning Mind2Web HuggingFace revision to expose official train/test_task/test_website/test_domain splits (resolving 73/3 vs 137/31 divergence, recording revision hash) for spec-compliant TF-IDF->k-means k=min(50,unique_train_tasks/20) fitted train-only with 1000 website-label shuffles, 2000 bootstraps and k/2,2k sensitivity — does AX_consistency >=0.6 demonstrate identifiable same-mechanism parameterized transfer within WebArena-Verified v2 and does Mind2Web excess >=0.10 demonstrate same-mechanism cross-website overlap sufficient to unblock Product within-store family holdout vs cold/retrieval/SPIDER with 0-token replay baseline?
hypothesis: H1_WEB_PARAM_IDENTIFIABILITY: WebArena-Verified v2 single Magento store (192 shopping tasks, 49 intent_templates, sha256 d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30) possesses identifiable same-mechanism parameterized transfer iff quantitative thresholds hold (family duplication >=0.5, param_task >=0.3, exact_copy <0.2, families_ge3 >=5 and families_ge4 >=3) AND element-pattern identifiability holds: AX_consistency >=0.6 where AX_consistency = fraction of sampled families where both tasks' live CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree trees at 1280x720 initial viewport contain the template-required AX role/name pattern via longest-prefix mapping without fallback, measured on >=20 trees task-specific navigated to category/product/cart start_url across >=10 families 2-per-family seed 35725763380. H2_MIND2WEB_CROSSSITE: Mind2Web official splits (train/test_website/test_domain from pinned HF revision exposing 137 sites/31 domains) contain measurable same-mechanism cross-website overlap under frozen mechanism TF-IDF(max_features 5000, ngram 1-2, min_df2, stop english)->k-means k=min(50,unique_train_tasks/20) fitted train-only (seed 35725763380) then predicted on test: overlap = |M_test_website intersect M_train|/|M_test_website| >=0.15 AND excess = overlap - shuffle_null_mean >=0.10 AND overlap > shuffle_p95 (1000 website-label shuffles) with bootstrap 95% CIs excluding thresholds by >=0.05 margin and k/2,2k sensitivity disclosed. H3_CENSUS_REPLICATION: WebArena census replicates parent exactly (192/49, duplication 0.9479, exact 0.0781, param 0.8958, families 36/34/33) confirming pin; failure triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.
falsifier: Gate0 INFRASTRUCTURE (precedence): if WebArena-Verified v2 JSON sha256 mismatches d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 irreconcilably OR Mind2Web HuggingFace unavailable after 3 retries OR pinned HF revision does not expose official train/test_task/test_website/test_domain splits (only single train 73/3/1009, revision unknown) then that axis is MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (status COMPLETE outcome NOT_APPLICABLE or BLOCKED) not FALSIFIED. Clause1 WEB WITHIN-STORE: if family_reuse <0.5 OR param_task <0.3 OR exact_copy >=0.2 OR families_ge3 <5 OR families_ge4 <3 OR AX_consistency <0.6 OR AX_consistency null/unmeasurable (fewer than 20 live trees OR fewer than 10 families with 2-per-family OR Playwright/CDP extraction fails OR navigation still homepage-only ?task=) OR PC1_WEB_SEARCH fails then WebArena within-store axis = FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for identifiable same-mechanism parameterized transfer. Clause2 MIND2WEB CROSS-WEBSITE: if spec-compliant TF-IDF/k-means executed on official splits and (overlap <0.15 OR excess <0.10 OR overlap <= shuffle_p95 OR param_prevalence <0.15 OR PC2 fails) then FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING; if spec-compliant mechanism/splits/null NOT executed (coarse heuristic, synthetic partition, label-shuffle null, unfitted k) then INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID per audit required_fixes not falsified. Clause3 SURVIVES requires Gate0 pass AND Clause1 AND Clause2 both pass AND NC2/NC3 behave AND bootstrap CIs exclude thresholds by >=0.05 margin. Clause4 MIXED if one axis passes and other is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING with per-axis bounded ceiling. Clause5 duplication 0.9479 with exact_copy <0.2 is NOT a falsifier (parameterized reuse). All thresholds frozen post-freeze.

This experiment reports measured fractions via instantiation_dict non-empty (WebArena) and TF-IDF/k-means cluster prevalence (Mind2Web) with bootstrap CIs, disclosing inflation gap and k/2,2k sensitivity.

baselines.description: SPIDER 2-site corpus (quotes+books) lower bound: 2 sites, no controlled novelty splits, minimal parameterized reuse. Any viable within-store or cross-website mechanism must exceed this bound qualitatively (template-family structure) and quantitatively.
baselines.expected: 36 families >=3 far exceeds 2-site; 137-site official Mind2Web far exceeds 2-site; bound trivially exceeded if thresholds met but quality via AX and shuffled null required.

baselines.description: Website-label permutation null (audit-required): permute website assignment labels across train+test_website 1000 perms seed 35725763380, recompute overlap each perm preserving per-split task counts, report mean/std/p95. Previous label-shuffle with random split_point rejected. AX diagnostic: shuffle instantiation labels to test AX threshold specificity.
baselines.expected: Shuffled overlap ~ chance (near 0 for well-separated sites under fine-grained clustering). True overlap must exceed mean by >=0.10 and exceed p95. High null (e.g., 0.998 under coarse k=50) indicates coarse clustering not website sharing; distinguished via k/2,2k.

baselines.description: Strong retrieval/replay framing for product design (TERX/HyperAgent 90ms/0-token replay, 23k->0 tokens 173x on stable tasks but fails on novel identifiers). Within-store holdout must be evaluated against cold/retrieval/SPIDER vs SPIDER+0-token replay; this Intel experiment quantifies substrate viability only, not LLM benefit. Prevents conflating 0.9479 duplication with inheritance benefit.
baselines.expected: Not executed here; disclosure only. Future Product holdout conditional on AX>=0.6 and Mind2Web excess>=0.10 substrates.

measurement_validity: WebArena-Verified v2 dataset pinned to ServiceNow/WebArena-Verified commit ef74e1bfd0d83d4bab1c55b2d1b4c2aeaac8e0d0, local file research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-35725763380/artifacts/raw/webarena-verified.json sha256 d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 (812 total, 192 shopping). Shopping census must be recomputed and match 192/49 or divergence reported with raw counts; sha divergence durable error no silent substitution.

Mind2Web dataset pinned to HuggingFace osunlp/Mind2Web via datasets library; MUST record HF revision hash (git commit), download date, per-split census train/test_task/test_website/test_domain task/website/domain counts. MUST attempt official splits; if HF exposes only single train (73 websites/3 domains/1009 tasks) document divergence to spec 137/31, do NOT fabricate synthetic website shuffle as substitute — report MEASUREMENT_INVALID with pinned revision, no synthetic overlap as if official.

Mechanism identity FROZEN BEFORE measurement and FIT ON TRAIN ONLY: WebArena mechanism = intent_template verbatim; param = instantiation_dict non-empty task-level or template has >=2 distinct instantiations template-level. Mind2Web mechanism = TF-IDF on concatenated (task instruction + action target/candidate element text) -> k-means k=min(50,unique_train_tasks/20) n_init 10 random_state 35725763380 fitted train-only then predict test. Vectorizer TF-IDF max_features 5000 ngram 1-2 lowercase stop english min_df 2. If unstable (n_samples<k or empty clusters or silhouette<0.05) fallback to exact (action_type,verb_lemma) bigram ONLY with disclosure and still report k/2,2k sensitivity. No post hoc redefinition after seeing overlap.

Accessibility-tree verification is LIVE CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree ONLY at 1280x720 initial viewport no scroll no cart/checkout execution. Sample >=20 tasks stratified 2-per-family across >=10 families (seed 35725763380) using task-specific navigation to category/product/cart start_url or product_id field (not ?task= homepage) — verify URL field vs homepage, disclose navigation mapping. Element-pattern mapping uses longest-prefix match without fallback: longest matching intent_template prefix among mapping table entries, distinct prefixes per template, no generic 'Add' fallthrough; table frozen in code before extraction and validated against product-page vs homepage AX (Add to Wish List absent homepage present product page). Save each AX tree with sha256, node counts, viewport, start_url, role extraction metadata. Below-fold/post-interaction excluded disclosed. If Playwright/Docker unavailable after 3 retries set AX_consistency=null with durable error and evaluate Clause1 as FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING per frozen rule.

Frozen seed 35725763380 for sampling, TF-IDF/k-means, bootstrap (2000 reps for 95% CIs on duplication, exact-copy, param fractions, AX_consistency, overlap fractions), and shuffle permutations (1000 perms for website-label null). Preprocessing fit on train only; test labels via transform/predict only. Report bootstrap CIs for all primary fractions and shuffle null mean/std/p95. Report k sensitivity for Mind2Web overlap: k/2 and 2k exploratory with same pipeline.

Raw artifacts preserved with sha256: webarena-verified.json hash verification, Mind2Web split JSONs or HF cache manifests with revision hash, >=20 live AX trees with task-specific URLs, derived measurements.json, bootstrap_ci.json, shuffle_null.json, TF-IDF vocab hash and k-means centroids hash. decision_rule: Frozen ordered evaluation; Gate0 precedence over scientific falsification. Gate0 Infrastructure: if WebArena JSON sha mismatch irreconcilable OR Mind2Web HF unavailable after 3 retries OR Mind2Web pinned revision does not expose official train/test_task/test_website/test_domain splits (e.g., single train 73/3 vs spec 137/31 revision unknown) then that axis verdict = MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (outcome NOT_APPLICABLE) not FALSIFIED. Clause1 WebArena within-store: if family_reuse <0.5 OR param_task <0.3 OR exact_copy >=0.2 OR families_ge3 <5 OR families_ge4 <3 OR AX_consistency <0.6 OR AX_consistency null/unmeasurable (<20 trees or <10 families 2-per-family or CDP fails or homepage-only navigation) OR PC1 fails then WebArena axis = FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for identifiable same-mechanism parameterized transfer. Clause2 Mind2Web cross-website: if spec-compliant TF-IDF/k-means on official splits executed and (overlap <0.15 OR excess <0.10 OR overlap <= shuffle_p95 OR param_prevalence <0.15 OR PC2 fails) then FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING; if spec-compliant mechanism/splits/null NOT executed then INCONCLUSIVE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsified. Clause3 SURVIVES requires Gate0 pass AND Clause1 AND Clause2 both pass AND NC2/NC3 behave AND bootstrap CIs exclude thresholds by >=0.05. Clause4 MIXED if one axis passes other FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING with per-axis bounded ceiling. Clause5 high duplication 0.9479 with exact_copy <0.2 not MIXED trigger. Thresholds frozen; no post hoc relaxation.
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES (both axes): Product/Graph UNBLOCKED to design within-store template-family holdout for C-PARAM-INHERIT/C-LLM-INHERIT on WebArena-Verified v2 (36 families >=3 enabling 2-train/1-test with AX>=0.6 live verification) AND Mind2Web website-holdout for C-CROSSSITE (overlap >=0.15 excess >=0.10). Next Product: train N per family/website, test held-out same family/website-sharing cluster with seed 35725763380 measuring parameterized resolution vs literal/retrieval vs SPIDER under 0-token replay (90ms TERX/HyperAgent 23k->0 framing). MIXED WebArena PASS + Mind2Web FAIL: proceed ONLY within-store holdout; do not claim cross-site generalization. MIXED opposite: within-store not identifiable; stay bounded to 2-site or Mind2Web-only website-holdout. Record TF-IDF/k-means artifacts for reuse.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIED WebArena axis (AX <0.6 or null or family thresholds fail): within-store family holdout NOT identifiable as same-mechanism parameterized transfer at element-pattern level despite census; C-PARAM-INHERIT/C-LLM-INHERIT cannot use WebArena-Verified v2 single-store families as same-mechanism testbed — Product stays bounded to 2-site corpus or Mind2Web-only website-holdout or custom benchmark; do not proceed to LLM-costly ranking. FALSIFIED Mind2Web axis (spec-compliant overlap <0.15 or excess <0.10): cross-website not demonstrably same-mechanism beyond website-label null; C-CROSSSITE website-holdout not demonstrably same-mechanism on Mind2Web at this granularity — future website-holdout limited to within-store families or custom construction. MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED (Mind2Web splits unavailable HF revision unknown or Playwright/Docker unavailable): no falsification; next action infra repair (pin HF revision with official splits, reinstall Playwright, re-pull container) and re-run; do not treat as negative. MIXED: proceed only on surviving axis with bounded ceiling. In all negative/inconclusive ceiling remains quantitative census only (192/49 duplication 0.9479 exact 0.0781 param 0.8958 families 36/34/33) with no LLM benefit demonstrated.
estimated_cost: LOW: no LLM API calls. WebArena census reuse <5 min; live AX extraction Docker pull am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945 (~1GB) + Playwright install (~300MB) + >=20 CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree extractions at 1280x720 with task-specific navigation (~40 min). Total <2.5h wall-clock, <4GB /tmp, stdlib+datasets+scikit-learn+playwright. No model calls.
expected_information_gain: HIGH (portfolio-level blocking dependency): Resolves 5 audit-required repairs blocking all Product within-store and website-holdout designs per Director portfolio (229 exps: no VALIDATED, C-CROSSSITE 5 recent MEASUREMENT_INVALID, C-PARAM-INHERIT starved 0/60 recent, C-LLM-INHERIT no same-model comparison, Graph 14/15 LOCAL tuning with diminishing returns, Physics/Frontier 58 synthetic). WebArena AX>=0.6 with task-specific navigation and longest-prefix mapping is falsifier for identifiable same-mechanism transfer beyond template-count level; without it Product holdout mixes incomparable mechanisms. Spec-compliant Mind2Web train-only TF-IDF/k-means on official splits with proper website-label shuffle + 2000 bootstraps + k/2,2k sensitivity is falsifier for same-mechanism cross-website overlap beyond coarse-heuristic artifact (previous excess -0.184 INCONCLUSIVE due to coarse 42 mechanisms and synthetic partition). Clean positive unlocks highest-leverage untested product promise (within-store holdout vs cold/retrieval/SPIDER with 0-token replay); clean spec-compliant negative prevents LLM waste and redirects to single-store count-level or custom benchmark. Decision-changing for C-CROSSSITE/C-PARAM-INHERIT/C-LLM-INHERIT.
